title: Course Registration
facts: System: Credit Hours | Language: English
Min load: 18cr/sem; extra allowed if CGPA≥3.30 + Sophomore+ OR graduation depends on it
Late reg: Week1 (advisor+dept head); dean extension before Week2 end (late fee applies)
Prereq: must pass before enrolling; co-req simultaneous only if prev failed OR graduation need (advisor+dept+dean approval)
Add/Drop: Weeks1–2 (min load must be maintained)
Withdrawal(W): ≤Week4 (advisor+instructor) | ≤Week12 (College Council); W on transcript
Absence >25%→auto fail (DN); must re-register
Audit(AU): counts in load, not in GPA | Transfer(TC): not in GPA
Repeat failed: once; latest grade counts; max 12cr repeatable total
Retry rules: up to 4 attempts; 1st fail not in GPA if improved on retry; 3rd/4th retry min grade=C
Repeat to improve grade below C: allowed; new grade only counts
Graduation: 146cr passed + CGPA≥2.0 + field training
146cr: Univ.req 14 + College req 72 (62 mandatory+10 elective) + Major 45 (39+6) + Minor 15
Univ.req(14cr): ENG111+ENG112+ENG113 + HUM101 + REM101 + ETS101 + MGT101; English exemption→substitute elective
Minor: 15cr from another dept's mandatory courses
Specializations(from Sem5): CS | IS | IT | DS; Sems1–4 common
Field training: mandatory; summer after Junior Sem2
ENG111: Sems1–2→1cr | ENG112: Sems3–4→1cr | ENG113: Sems5–6→2cr
Project(CS/IS/IT/DS 405): 6cr; Sems7–8; oral+report+practical; 2-faculty committee (1 external min)
Common Sem1(18cr): ENG111+REM101+MGT101+MT101+PH101+CS101+CS202
Common Sem2(18cr): ENG111+HUM101+ETS101+MT111+CS112+CS113+CS114+IT301
Common Sem3(18cr): ENG112+MT201+CS205+MT301+CS203+CS215+CS214
Common Sem4(18cr): ENG112+MT311+CS212+MT211+CS308+CS312+CS216
CS Sem5: ENG113+CS302+CS404+CS305+2elec | Sem6: +IT403+CS304+CS313+CS310+2elec | Sem7: CS401+CS402+3elec+CS405 | Sem8: CS411+CS314+3elec+CS405
IS Sem5: ENG113+IS302+IS303+IS304+2elec | Sem6: +IS404+IS320+IT403+IS314+2elec | Sem7: IS403+IS402+IS405+3elec | Sem8: IS312+IS412+IS405+3elec
IT Sem5: ENG113+IS303+CS304+CS305+2elec | Sem6: +IT314+IS312+CS313+IT403+2elec | Sem7: IT401+IT404+IT405+3elec | Sem8: IT411+IT412+IT405+3elec
DS Sem5: ENG113+DS302+IS303+DS301+2elec | Sem6: +DS314+CS307+DS305+DS401+2elec | Sem7: DS411+IS404+DS405+3elec | Sem8: DS413+DS301+DS405+3elec
